description: Kindi 0.7.0: fast local LLM inference on low-cost GPUs and CPUs. Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (125B MoE) at 13.1 tok/s on an 8 GB Quadro M4000, 2.4x llama.cpp on the same card. Also DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, Ternary Bonsai 2B-27B, AH-Nanbeige4.3-33B, Nemotron 3.5 Lightning. NVIDIA from the Quadro K420 to the RTX 50 series, AMD Radeon (RDNA2+), Windows and Linux.
summary: A custom LLM inference engine for low-cost GPUs: NVIDIA cards from a 1 GB Quadro K420 to an RTX 3080, the AMD Radeon 780M and the CPU. Runs the Bonsai 2B to 27B models and Nemotron with an OpenAI-compatible server.
